scene: At a stone hilltop lookout after sunset, she looks through plain compact binoculars toward the lower mountain ridges beneath the first stars; cool blue twilight and a warm side lantern.
outfit: A deep-green boat-neck long-sleeve ribbed top, its neckline sitting evenly along both collarbones, ending at the waist; separate ivory wide-leg trousers and an earth-brown hip-length open waistcoat with small oak-leaf earrings.
